Article 5.3: Per-Account Payout Caps

Warren's summary

All funded accounts are subject to per-account payout caps effective April 20, 2026, with different limits for payouts 1–3 versus payouts 4 and beyond based on your account size. In addition to the per-account cap, no single user may withdraw more than $10,000 total across all funded accounts in a single payout event, and whichever cap is lower applies. Accounts purchased before October 22, 2026 and not reset since keep their original higher payout caps, while accounts purchased on or after that date use the new lower caps. OG funded accounts activated before April 20, 2026 are exempt from per-account caps and only subject to the $10,000 per-user cap.

How Caps Work

All funded accounts, OG and MAX, are subject to per-account payout caps effective April 20, 2026. The cap applies on a per-payout basis. The cap is tiered based on how many payouts have been made FROM THAT SPECIFIC ACCOUNT. This is not based on the number of accounts you hold: it is the payout count for each individual account.

Per-Account Caps by Account Size
Account Size	Payouts 1–3 (Per Account)	Payouts 4+ (Per Account)
$25,000	$750	$900
$50,000	$1,000	$1,250
$100,000	$1,500	$1,750
$150,000	$1,750	$2,000
$250,000	$2,000	$2,500

Accounts purchased before October 22, 2026 and not reset since keep the payout caps they were purchased with:

Account Size	Payouts 1–3	Payouts 4+
$25,000	$1,000	$1,200
$50,000	$1,500	$2,000
$100,000	$2,000	$2,500
$150,000	$2,500	$3,000
$250,000	$3,000	$3,500
The $10,000 Per-User Per-Payout Cap

In addition to the per-account cap, no single user may withdraw more than $10,000 total across all funded accounts in a single payout event.

Which Cap Applies?

Always the lesser of the two.

Note: FFN Institution (live) accounts have no consistency rule and no per-account payout cap. Institution payouts are your 90% share of eligible live profit, processed the same business day, and the account must keep its Permanent Risk Buffer to stay open (see Article 4.3). The caps below apply to all Sim-Funded accounts (OG and MAX). OG funded accounts activated before April 20, 2026 (account numbers beginning with 7PV) are subject to the previous payout structure: no per-account cap, only the $10,000 per-user cap. OG funded accounts activated on or after April 20, 2026 are subject to the per-account caps listed below.

Example 1: You have five 50K MAX funded accounts, all on their first payout. The per-account cap is $1,000 × 5 = $5,000 potential. Since $5,000 is below the $10,000 user cap, your limit is $5,000.
Key Rules: All Account Types
Minimum withdrawal: $500 per request
An account reset on or after October 22, 2026 moves to the caps for accounts purchased on or after October 22, 2026.
Consistency resets per account after each payout. Your best day P&L does not reset.
Express MAX funded accounts require 5 new winning days after each payout before the next withdrawal is permitted.
Payout fees are charged if applicable on Rise, PayPal, or Rise.
